_meta.compiled_for: neurogolf-2026 (IJCAI-ECAI 2026, smallest ONNX neural networks for ARC-AGI image transformations, $50,000)
_meta.ordering: structurally most-similar past comp flagged 'structural_relevance: maximum' (split into 軸 A: ARC-solving and 軸 B: NN-compression)
_meta.schema_note: Each top-level non-_ key is a past_comp_id (snake_case). _meta and _cross_comp_synthesis are special.
_meta.url_check_status: all 200 OK or mirrored via Wayback (W3 verified)

arc_prize_2024.structural_relevance_reason: ARC-AGI 解法 (軸 A) で最も近い、refinement loop / per-task adaptation paradigm が dominant
arc_prize_2024.architecture: Qwen-4B + per-task LoRA adapter + TTT-refiner, ensemble with symbolic search
arc_prize_2024.n_teams_note: Multi-million dollar prize, attracted strongest competitors
key_tricks: Test-time training (TTT) with LoRA adapters per task ([source](https://arxiv.org/html/2411.07279v1))
Geometric augmentation (rotation, flip) + leave-one-out task generation
Hybrid transduction (direct grid→grid) + induction (program synthesis)
Refinement loop: iterative program/parameter optimization on demo pairs
arc_prize_2024.transfer_to_current_comp: NeuroGolf static ONNX cannot do test-time gradient. However, (1) synthetic augmentation (leave-one-out) is directly portable; (2) refinement loop idea → compile symbolic program to small NN → refine via compression; (3) transduction as fallback for hard tasks. Recommend: stage 1 program synthesis (DSL), stage 2 NN compile, stage 3 compress to 1.44 MB.
arc_prize_2024.notes: State-of-art jumped 33% → 55.5% in single year. Test-time refinement (not inference) is key. NeuroGolf constraint (no Scan/Loop) requires unrolling recursion.

micronet_2019.structural_relevance_reason: NN 圧縮 (軸 B) で最も近い、cost = params + memory bytes が直接同型
micronet_2019.architecture: Transformer-XL ベース + adaptive embedding/softmax + factorization + AGP pruning + 8-bit quantization-aware training
key_tricks: Adaptive embedding & softmax (weight sharing, rank factorization) — 5-10% param 削減
Knowledge distillation with teacher annealing schedule
Automatic Gradual Pruning (AGP) + 8-bit quantization → 35-49× total compression ([source](https://arxiv.org/abs/1510.00149))
Symmetric range-based linear quantizers; tested 8-bit, 4-bit, ternary
micronet_2019.transfer_to_current_comp: MicroNet 1.8 M params (32-bit) → NeuroGolf 360 K FP32 (= 1.44 MB / 4) は straightforward scale-down。すべての 技法 (pruning pipeline, quantization strategy, teacher annealing) が直接転用可。注意: ONNX quantization は QuantizeLinear + DequantizeLinear operator で。Combined pruning + quantization は careful scheduling (prune → quantize) が必要。Phase 2-3 dedicated track として実装推奨。
micronet_2019.notes: Industry-standard compression pipeline。Per-layer pruning ratios と quantization bit-widths は tuning 必須。Pruning と quantization は同時 apply 不可、sequential が原則。

abstraction_reasoning_2019.structural_relevance_reason: DSL + program synthesis の初代 ARC SOTA、NeuroGolf の symbolic baseline 候補
abstraction_reasoning_2019.architecture: DSL (142 unary grid functions) + greedy composition + DAG cache + depth-limited search
key_tricks: Handcrafted DSL with 142 primitive operations (rotate, flip, crop, color-transform, etc.)
Greedy depth-first composition + DAG caching (avoid recomputation)
Depth-limited search (1-3 iterations) for speed/accuracy tradeoff
abstraction_reasoning_2019.transfer_to_current_comp: DSL 再利用可能 — symbolic baseline として first principles に従って 142 primitive を再実装。compile to lookup tables or small FC layers. Symbolic は interpretability 高、hardcoded DSL の overfitting risk あり。Recommend hybrid: DSL for easy tasks (= 1-2 layer conv で encode 可能), NN for hard. ONNX no Loop/Scan constraint で DSL composition steps は explicit unroll が必要。
abstraction_reasoning_2019.notes: Foundation work; ARC Prize 2024 hybrid に拡張された。142 ops は practical, not excessive。2019 SOTA は purely symbolic、later paradigm shift toward neural.

compressarc_2025.venue: standalone (arXiv + GitHub + ARC Prize 2025 paper award)
compressarc_2025.structural_relevance_reason: 76K params で ARC を解く、NeuroGolf の 1.44 MB 制約に最も近い実装例
compressarc_2025.architecture: Small NN (variable depth) + VAE loss + L1 decoder regularization, trained per-puzzle from scratch
key_tricks: Minimum Description Length (MDL) formulation: shortest program likely to generalize
VAE loss + L1 penalty on weights/activations → sparse gradient descent (no combinatorial search)
Per-task training from random init (no pretraining, no dataset)
Decoder regularization directly controls parameter count
compressarc_2025.transfer_to_current_comp: CompressARC は ONNX 1.44 MB 制約に最適化済の設計で **直接転用可**。L1 weight regularization が fitting メカニズムの中心。VAE loss + decoder penalty を adopt。注意: 76 K params で 20-34% 達成、private test (4% on ARC-AGI-2) では難しい問題で大幅劣化。Recommend: CompressARC baseline で benchmark、symbolic solution (Stage 1) を layer in。Per-task hyperparameter tuning critical (L1 weight, regularization strength)。
compressarc_2025.notes: No pretraining is feature (not bug) for NeuroGolf。All computation is inference + optional per-task refinement、ONNX constraints と完全 compatible。ARC Prize 2025 paper award。

tiny_recursive_model_2025.structural_relevance_reason: 7 M params で 45% ARC-AGI-1、minimal recursive architecture (unrolled loop で ONNX compatible)
tiny_recursive_model_2025.architecture: Single 2-layer network + iterate 4-16 steps: alternate latent 'think' update (state refinement) and 'act' (output prediction); deep supervision on all intermediate steps
key_tricks: Minimal architecture (2 layers, small width) で 7 M params で 45% accuracy
Unrolled recursion (no Scan/Loop operators) — backprop through all steps (vs. HRM 1-step implicit gradient)
Deep supervision on intermediate outputs → 強い gradient signal
Alternating latent refinement + output prediction (similar to EM or variational inference)
tiny_recursive_model_2025.transfer_to_current_comp: TRM 7 M params → 360 K FP32 は 20× compression が必要 (quantization + pruning)。Architecture design (minimal depth/width, unrolled loop) は直接適用可。Recommend: TRM を ensemble component として使用 (CompressARC や symbolic baseline と weight-normalized average)。Challenge: ONNX static shape は pre-determined unroll count が必要 (not adaptive)、4-8 iterations が現実的。Backprop through unroll は ONNX linear size limit を超える可能性、layer-wise unroll で test。
tiny_recursive_model_2025.notes: Recursive refinement は 2024-2025 の trend (ARC Prize, SOAR, TRM 全て)。Tiny networks が 45%+ を達成可能。o3-mini, Gemini 2.5 Pro などの大型 LLM を outperform at 0.01% params。

soar_2025.structural_relevance_reason: LLM-based program synthesis + self-improving loop、ARC を解いて program を NN に compile する流れに直結
soar_2025.architecture: Open-source LLM (Qwen, etc.) + evolutionary loop: sample programs (Python DSL) → test → refine → hindsight learning (convert attempts to training pairs) → fine-tune LLM (LoRA)
key_tricks: Sampling phase: LLM generate thousands of candidate programs, rank by test accuracy
Refinement phase: LLM modify top-k via mutation and verifier feedback
Hindsight learning: all attempts (wins + losses) → training pairs, fine-tune LLM (LoRA), improve next iteration
No human-engineered DSL (unlike icecuber); learns from its own attempts
soar_2025.transfer_to_current_comp: SOAR は Python code generation (non-ONNX)。NeuroGolf では: (1) SOAR で synthesize した per-task programs を offline で生成、(2) compile outputs to small NN (lookup table, FC layer)、(3) quantize to 1.44 MB。Hindsight learning idea → per-task parameter refinement は転用可。Recommend phase 1-2: pretrained Qwen-4B or open LLM を program synthesizer として使用、cache outputs。Phase 3: batch compile to ONNX。
soar_2025.notes: Iterative improvement (refinement loop) は 2024-2025 で dominant theme。SOAR は open-source LLM (no custom fine-tuning dataset) で 52% 達成、accessible。NeuroGolf の program synthesis engine として使える。

arc_prize_2025.structural_relevance_reason: 最新 SOTA (NVARC 24% on ARC-AGI-2)、refinement loop paradigm の most explicit な report
arc_prize_2025.architecture: Ensemble: (A) Improved ARChitects (Qwen-4B + LoRA TTT), (B) TRM single-block recursive refiner, combined via voting
key_tricks: Synthetic puzzle generation: 260K new puzzles via combining existing puzzle descriptions
TTT + LoRA per task (improved from 2024 ARChitects baseline)
TRM single block (1 layer unrolled, not 2): lighter weight, same 45% ARC-AGI-1 capability
Disciplined engineering: pragmatic trade-off under compute/time constraints, avoid brute-force
arc_prize_2025.transfer_to_current_comp: NVARC 24% on harder ARC-AGI-2 が現在の floor。Synthetic data generation と TRM は NeuroGolf に直接転用可。NVARC は Qwen-4B (~7B params)、ONNX 1.44 MB と incompatible。ただし、(1) synthetic data methodology は offline で安く生成、(2) TRM single-block は smaller、ONNX compile feasible。Recommend: synthetic generation を adopt、TRM + CompressARC ensemble を benchmark。
arc_prize_2025.notes: 2025 emphasizes disciplined engineering over brute-force。Refinement loop (per-task iteration) proven dominant。Data augmentation crucial で limited public eval set 対応。

google_code_golf_2025.structural_relevance_reason: Code golf (minimize Python program length) on ARC-like tasks; tangential to NeuroGolf neural network compression focus
google_code_golf_2025.architecture: Rule-based code compression, heuristics for loop/function body compaction
key_tricks: Character-level optimization: remove whitespace, use concise variable names
Algorithmic compaction: implicit loops (list comprehension, numpy broadcasting)
google_code_golf_2025.transfer_to_current_comp: Low direct transfer; program golf は orthogonal to neural network encoding。useful reference for symbolic solution compaction (例: DSL → Python → ONNX deployment) だが、NeuroGolf focus is NN weights, not code size。
google_code_golf_2025.notes: Complementary to NeuroGolf (symbolic programs vs. neural weights)。Combined possible (例: symbolic program as program golf candidate, neural as fallback)。

when_heuristic_won: Abstraction & Reasoning Challenge 1st (icecuber, 2019) — DSL + DAG solver, CPU only
when_program_synthesis_won: ARC Prize 2025 1st (NVARC, TTT + TRM ensemble + synthetic data)
_cross_comp_synthesis.trend: 2019 までは ARC で symbolic DSL が dominant (icecuber)。2024 で TTT + LLM が出現し 53.5% へ大幅 jump (ARChitects)。2025 では (a) refinement loop が universal、(b) tiny networks (76K-7M params) が大型 LLM を outperform、(c) synthetic augmentation が必須となった。NeuroGolf は ARC 解法 + NN 圧縮 の二重目的なので、これら trend が交わる Hybrid (Symbolic synthesis + Compressed NN) が有力候補。
transferable_recipe_for_current_comp: Phase 1 (week 1-2): handcrafted DSL baseline (icecuber 142 primitives 由来)、easy task で 1-2 layer conv で encode
Phase 2 (week 3-4): LLM-driven program synthesis (SOAR pattern) で残りの medium task をカバー
Phase 3 (week 5-6): NN compression pipeline (MicroNet 由来 — magnitude pruning → 8-bit QuantizeLinear)
Phase 4 (week 7-8): ensemble (CompressARC + TRM unroll + symbolic fallback)、private eval refinement、submission strategy
mandatory_tricks: Refinement loop / per-task adaptation (= ARC Prize 2024-2025, SOAR で universal)
Synthetic data augmentation (= ARChitects, NVARC で必須、leave-one-out + geometric transforms)
Pruning + 8-bit quantization pipeline (= MicroNet, CompressARC で proven)
Static-shape unroll (= ONNX no Loop/Scan 制約への対応、TRM の recursive unroll を adapt)
